name: Snap
description: Shake a window you are dragging and the notch opens: drop it on a half, a corner or the whole screen.
author: Giuseppe
details: Snap puts a window where you want it without a keyboard shortcut. Grab a window by its title bar and shake it from side to side: the notch opens with a small screen drawn in it (or, if you prefer, it opens every time you drag a window): an arrow at the middle of each side, a dot in the centre. Bring the pointer to an arrow and the window will go to that half of the screen, to a corner and it takes that quarter, to the dot and it fills the screen. The cells are not drawn: the one under the pointer simply grows a little, with a soft preview of where the window will land. Let go to place it.
features: Left and right halves, top and bottom halves, four quarters and the whole screen
The notch opens when you shake the window, so you can still move windows freely
A preview of where the window will go
Works on every display, with an optional space between windows
permissions: Accessibility, to move and resize windows (Notcholino asks for it already for the volume HUD).
